game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Coastal Port – Sandbar Crossing, a sandbar at low tide: the deckhand must handle sea serpents while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – And/Or Locks: Combine conditions with and/or to open a lock that needs several clues.
theme: Coastal Port – Sandbar Crossing: a sandbar at low tide
core_gameplay_loop: In Sandbar Crossing, repeat each round: Combine conditions with and/or to open a lock that needs several clues. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the lock_progress value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 6 consecutive correct decisions about lock_progress to power up the deckhand and open the treasure chest.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 3 (intro tier): And/Or Locks
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'And/Or Locks' (Week 3 slot 4), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Sandbar Crossing'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lock_progress changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sea serpents in Sandbar Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 6.
